scaffold.note: Only tocopherol's C2 is assigned. The 4' and 8' side-chain centres are left unassigned because the paper names no isomer, so every structure below carries stereo uncertainty that mass cannot see.

lipids.name: VN3C2O
lipids.why: No amine drawn in Figure S1a has formula C7H18N2O2. The two bis(hydroxyethyl) amines drawn (CAS 4439-20-7 and 3197-06-6) are both C6H16N2O2, exactly one CH2 short. Under the VN2/VN3 = ethylene/propylene reading the core would be the propylene homologue of 3197-06-6, which the paper does not draw.

lipids.name: VN2C4
lipids.why: TWO drawn amines have formula C6H14N2: 7154-73-6 (1-(2-aminoethyl)pyrrolidine, one 2-arm site) and 694-83-7 (trans-1,2-diaminocyclohexane, two 1-arm sites). They differ in connectivity and the exact mass cannot see the difference.

lipids.name: VN2C2
lipids.why: Exactly one drawn amine has formula C6H16N2 (CAS 100-36-7, N,N-diethylethylenediamine) and exactly one of its nitrogens carries two hydrogens, so the two arms have only one site. Its +CH2 partner 104-78-9 is also drawn, which is what the measured CH2 ladder predicts.

lipids.name: VN3C2
lipids.why: TWO drawn amines have formula C7H18N2: 104-78-9 (N,N-diethyl-1,3-propanediamine) and 10061-68-4 (N,N'-diethyl-1,3-propanediamine). The CH2 ladder discriminates: VN3C2 = VN2C2 + CH2 to 0.05 mDa, and the linker homologue of VN2C2's core (100-36-7) is 104-78-9, not 10061-68-4.

lipids.name: VN3C1
lipids.why: Exactly one drawn amine has formula C5H14N2 (CAS 109-55-7, N,N-dimethyl-1,3-propanediamine) and exactly one of its nitrogens carries two hydrogens.

lipids.name: PANEL-G (label disputed)
lipids.why: The caption labels this VN3C2, but panel (e) already labels a DIFFERENT formula VN3C2 and the two differ by H2. Exactly one drawn amine has C7H16N2 (51387-90-7), but the compound's NAME is unresolved, so it cannot be joined to any value.

lipids.name: VN2C1
lipids.why: NO amine drawn in Figure S1a has formula C4H12N2. This is the paper's LEAD compound (Figures S8, S12, S13 and all in-vivo work). Under the CH2-ladder reading the core is the ethylene homologue of 109-55-7, i.e. N,N-dimethylethylenediamine (CAS 108-00-9) - which the figure does not draw. Figure S1a says 35 amines and draws 34 distinct ones (7209-38-3 twice), so exactly one slot is unaccounted for; that is suggestive and is not evidence.
